name: git-repo-scaffolder
title: Git Repo Scaffolder
author: TIBCO Software Inc.
description: Generates a project from a template folder in any Git repository: applies a token -> value map to file contents and paths, then pushes the result as one commit into a folder of a shared repository or into a new repository. Pure Go (no git CLI).

display.description: Scaffold a repository (or a folder in one) from a Git template with token replacement

inputs.name: authToken
inputs.description: Token used for git over HTTPS and for the repository API (map from a secret app property)

inputs.name: templateAuthToken
inputs.description: Optional separate token for reading the template repository; defaults to authToken

inputs.name: templateRepoURL
inputs.description: HTTPS clone URL of the repository holding the templates

inputs.name: templateRef
inputs.description: Branch or tag to read; empty = the repository's default branch

inputs.name: templatePath
inputs.description: Folder inside the template repository to use as the template root; empty = whole repository

inputs.name: replacements
inputs.description: Token -> value map applied to text file contents and to file/folder names (longest token first)

inputs.name: replacementList
inputs.description: Same as replacements but as [{token, value}] so token names can be computed at runtime (e.g. <templateName>.module); entries override replacements

inputs.name: ignoreEmptyValues
inputs.description: Skip tokens whose value is empty instead of replacing them with an empty string

inputs.name: replacementMode
inputs.description: sequential: each token is applied to the result of the previous one (tokens may produce other tokens); singlePass: one scan, replaced text is never re-matched

inputs.name: renamePaths
inputs.description: Also apply the replacements to file and folder names (tokens containing / or \ are content-only)

inputs.name: excludePatterns
inputs.description: Files to leave out: "name" or "*.ext" (any depth), "dir/" (directory at any depth), "a/b/*.x" (full path), "**/a/*.x" (any trailing path)

inputs.name: binaryExtensions
inputs.description: Extra extensions to copy without replacement (common binary types and files containing NUL bytes are always skipped)

inputs.name: maxTextBytes
inputs.description: Files larger than this are copied without replacement

inputs.name: targetMode
inputs.description: subfolder: write into targetFolder of an existing repository; newRepo: create the repository (GitHub API) and write into it

inputs.name: targetRepoURL
inputs.description: HTTPS URL of the target repository, e.g. https://github.com/owner/name

inputs.name: targetBranch
inputs.description: Branch to commit to

inputs.name: targetFolder
inputs.description: Folder in the target repository (required in subfolder mode; optional in newRepo mode)

inputs.name: cleanTargetFolder
inputs.description: Remove the folder's existing files first, so files no longer produced by the template are deleted

inputs.name: newRepoPrivate
inputs.description: newRepo mode: create the repository as private

inputs.name: newRepoDescription
inputs.description: newRepo mode: repository description

inputs.name: failIfRepoExists
inputs.description: newRepo mode: fail if the repository already exists (otherwise write into it)

inputs.name: apiBaseURL
inputs.description: Repository API base URL (GitHub Enterprise: https://<host>/api/v3)

inputs.name: commitMessage
inputs.description: Commit message

inputs.name: authorName
inputs.description: Commit author name

inputs.name: authorEmail
inputs.description: Commit author email

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.description: Fetch and transform only; nothing is created or pushed

inputs.name: pushRetries
inputs.description: Attempts when another writer pushes to the branch at the same time

inputs.name: writeStrategy
inputs.description: api: commit through the GitHub Git Data API (no clone, only changed files are sent; cost independent of the target repository size). git: clone + push (any Git host). auto: api for github.com or a configured apiBaseURL, git otherwise and for empty repositories

inputs.name: timeoutSeconds
inputs.description: Overall timeout for the activity

outputs.name: repoURL
outputs.description: Web URL of the target repository

outputs.name: folderURL
outputs.description: Web URL of the generated folder (or the repository)

outputs.name: commitSHA
outputs.description: New commit, or the current branch tip when nothing changed

outputs.name: templateCommit
outputs.description: Template repository commit that was used

outputs.name: pushed
outputs.description: false when the output was identical to what is already in the repository (or dryRun)

outputs.name: writeMode
outputs.description: How the commit was written: api or git

outputs.name: filesModified
outputs.description: Files whose content changed through replacements

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: Generated file paths inside the target repository
